# Pihu Farm Fresh Makhana

> Pihu Farm Fresh Makhana, based in Bangalore (Bengaluru), Karnataka, sells raw 5+ suta phool makhana (fox nuts) sourced from growers in Darbhanga and Purnia, Bihar. A 250 g pack costs ₹299 (MRP ₹499), or ₹119.60 per 100 g. Delivered across Bangalore (Bengaluru), and across India for bulk orders.

## Product
- Raw phool makhana (fox nuts), 5+ suta, 250 g (500 g and 1 kg on request)
- Sold raw: roast or cook before eating
- Origin: Darbhanga and Purnia, Bihar
- Ingredients: Makhana
- Shelf life: 2 years from the date of manufacture
- Storage: airtight container, cool and dry place

## How to order
- WhatsApp and call: 7550264699
- Email: satyamgoyal008@gmail.com
- We confirm availability, delivery charge and payment before dispatch, and reply within 1 business day. No online checkout.
